text:
maya_marketing: Quick creative sprint — need compact asset set for the Jun 12 webinar + paid/social push. 

maya_marketing: Deliverables (compact): 1) Landing hero (1600x600) + email hero (1200x628) static, 2) 1-panel benchmark visual (1200x628) that can also be a slide image, 3) three social variants (square, story loop <1.5MB, linkedin banner), 4) a micro-diagram SVG showing routing/cache effect for the deck. Localize: EN/JP/KO. Due by end of day Tue (48 hrs). Figma brief: https://figma.com/redwood/compact-webinar-brief (placeholder)

rafi_design: A few Qs: prefer GIF or MP4 for story? and do you want separate files per locale or translated frames?

maya_marketing: MP4 preferred for story loop (h264, small). Translated frames per locale in the same Figma file please. Also keep copy in single text layers.

zoe_copy: Copy to use: Headline A "Ship inference with predictable latency"; Headline B "Cut per-token cost without sacrificing latency"; Subhead "Jun 12 webinar: demo + benchmark"; CTA variants "Register" / "Save my seat". I'll provide JP/KO strings by tomorrow 9am PT.

rafi_design: For the benchmark visual: do we do three plotted points (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) + an arrow showing "after routing/caching"? Or small before/after inset?

maya_marketing: Three points + subtle before/after overlay. Keep axes labeled (latency ms, $/1k tokens). Use teal + warm orange; avoid alarm red. Add short captions for each point.

luca_i18n: Reminder: avoid idioms and long compound sentences so JP/KO translations fit. Please provide character counts and keep CTA under 20 chars.

vince_legal: No competitor logos. If using customer names/quotes, upload signed consent. Also, any performance claims like "30% cheaper" need source — flag if you plan to include numbers.

figma-bot: Figma file created: Compact-Webinar-Pack. Frames: hero-1600x600, hero-email-1200x628, bench-1200x628, diag-svg, social-square-1080x1080, social-story-1080x1920, linkedin-1200x627. Link: https://figma.com/file/compact123 (placeholder)

rafi_design: I'll lay out quick comps and keep copy editable. ETA initial sketches: tomorrow 10am PT. Will export PNG/WebP and SVG.

zoe_copy: I'll drop final copy + alt text by 8:30am PT tomorrow.

luca_i18n: If copy's in by 9am, I can turn JP/KO around in ~14 hours.

maya_marketing: Priority order: 1) landing hero + CTA, 2) benchmark image for deck, 3) social. Legal review on finals please. Ping me if any blockers. :sparkles:
